text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while swamped with paperwork...
I happened to glance outside...
and saw a cat leisurely sunbathing.
choice_data_list: Cats are nice, huh... so laid-back and carefree...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A cat...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, please have this...
I just happened to make some cat latte art.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a magnificent piece of work. The adorable expression
captivates the eyes. Within those round cat-like eyes…….

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Sucked... in... —

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...When I came to, I was in an unfamiliar room.
As I went to rub my eyes, I looked down at my hands...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Good morning, little black cat.
Did you sleep well...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Your coat is always so beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Manhattan Cafe strokes my head.
It feels so good that..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A purr naturally escapes my throat. As if doing this
has always been the most natural thing in the world...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my... A few hairballs...?
...I'll brush your coat for you..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Look how fluffy you've become.
Let me give your belly a pet too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Shall we play with some toys next...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe places the ball on the floor.
Watching it roll, an odd urge wells up inside—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you played so much.
You must be hungry, right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Now, please eat right from my palm.
Slowly... take your time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's such lovely weather outside again today.
With two suns shining so brightly down... so cheerful—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu.
Are you sleepy? Well then...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Relax your body... and sleep.
I will hold you close...
so you don't fall off my lap.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Looks like she fell asleep, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I was actually quite worried about you.
You've been pushing yourself so hard lately."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You are such a hard worker...
I think you're admirable every single day... But—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: When you're feeling down, I get lonely... so please take care.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So... sometimes, we can do this...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —sw... eeten... er...—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please wake up...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She's in the trainer's office...
After drinking her latte, she started dozing off...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems I had dozed off.
And... I feel like I was having some kind of dream.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...How are you feeling?
Is there anything hurting...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from it, I'm brimming with vitality.
It feels as though my mind and body have been completely refreshed...
choice_data_list: I feel like I had a nice dream...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
Even so, please do not push yourself too hard..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Even so, if you get tired... I will, once again...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No. It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What kind of dream is it...?
choice_data_list: A dream of becoming a cat and playing with you
A dream of becoming a cat and playing with you

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's... a lovely dream.
However...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...If you ever want to become a cat again,
please let me know anytime.
